facts.text: Russell's last drink before he goes up.
facts.why: Russell quits drinking before the final flight. His line is 'I picked a hell of a day to quit drinkin'.' The beer is the opposite of what he does.
facts.fix: Russell picked a hell of a day to quit.

facts.text: Everybody eat together tonight. Whatever comes tomorrow, nobody faces it on an empty stomach.
facts.why: Whitmore never says this and there is no shared dinner in the film. His real speech to the pilots at Area 51 includes 'Mankind. That word should have new meaning for all of us today.'
facts.fix: Mankind. That word should have new meaning for all of us today.
